adjudication.rationale: In EventManager.update() (the try block handling calendarReference now uses `filter` to process all `_calendar` references), the merge-on-reschedule cleanup path still does `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));` when `newBookingId` is provided. Given this PR changes creation/update flows to support multiple destination calendars and multiple `_calendar` references (one per host/destination), using `find` here will select only the first old calendar reference and therefore only delete one old calendar event, leaving other hosts' old calendar events orphaned/stale.
